site.title: ICM Cerebral SVD Dashboard
site.heading: Putative Causal Genes and Clinical Trial Drugs for Cerebral Small Vessel Disease
site.metaDescription: Interactive dashboard of putative causal genes and clinical trial drugs for cerebral small vessel disease, from the Paris Brain Institute (ICM).
site.aboutTitle: Welcome to the Paris Brain Institute's Cerebral SVD Dashboard
site.aboutLede: This dashboard provides up-to-date and standardized information on putative cerebral small vessel disease (SVD) causal genes and drugs tested in planned or ongoing cerebral SVD clinical trials.
site.loginLede: Putative causal genes and clinical trial drugs for cerebral small vessel disease (SVD).

pages.genes: Genes implicated in cerebral small vessel disease (SVD), with the GWAS, omics and monogenic evidence supporting each one.
pages.trials: Drugs tested in planned or ongoing cerebral small vessel disease (SVD) trials, grouped by drug.
pages.timeline: Planned and ongoing cerebral small vessel disease (SVD) trials, arranged by target population and trial phase.
pages.map: Facility locations for the registered cerebral small vessel disease (SVD) trials.
